# DeepSeek++ attribution

The DeepSeek Web protocol adapter uses protocol behavior and the
`sha3_wasm_bg.wasm` proof-of-work binary from:

- Project: `zhu1090093659/deepseek-pp`
- Source: https://github.com/zhu1090093659/deepseek-pp
- Reference commit used for this integration: `0a02c72`
- License: Apache License 2.0 (see `LICENSE` in this directory)

The surrounding Browser AI Bridge integration, Codex Responses translation,
credential isolation, and Native Messaging glue are implemented in this
repository.
